sections.title: A selective register of restored identity

blocks.text: The register in 1 Chronicles 9 should be read as a selective literary map of kinship, land, office, and restored identity rather than as an exhaustive modern biological pedigree. In the available context, 'all Israel' includes Judah-centered institutions while also incorporating northern and Transjordanian tribes; it should not be reduced either to a narrow biological category or to a claim that every group was equally present. The chapter thus connects the restored community with Adam, Israel's tribes, David, priests, Levites, and preexilic Jerusalem through chosen genealogies and registers.
